name: banner-design
tagline_zh: 社交媒体、广告、网页首图、印刷品，一句话生成多风格横幅。内置10种艺术方向，AI配图，告别千篇一律的模板。
tagline_en: One prompt, multiple art directions. AI-crafted banners for social, ads, web, and print—10 styles, no templates.
desc_en: Design banners for social media, ads, website heroes, creative assets, and print. Multiple art direction options with AI-generated visuals. Actions: design, create, generate banner. Platforms: Facebook, Twitter/X, LinkedIn, YouTube, Instagram, Google Display, website hero, print. Styles: minimalist, gradient, bold typography, photo-based, illustrated, geometric, retro, glassmorphism, 3D, neon, duo
why_zh: 同类工具只给模板，它给的是艺术方向选择——从极简到霓虹，AI配图，每个横幅都像定制。
why_en: Unlike template mills, it offers 10 distinct art directions with AI visuals—each banner feels bespoke, not boilerplate.
